The '''Chaf family''',<ref name="SQ">''[[Survivor's Quest]]''</ref> also called '''House Chaf''',<ref name="TEA" /> and formerly known as the '''Fifth Ruling Family''' or '''Fifth Family''', was a [[Chiss family/Legends|Chiss family]] in the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]]. It was once one of the [[Ruling Families/Legends|Nine Ruling Families]] which provided leadership for the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] people. In keeping with the Chiss custom of indicating an individual's role by the color scheme of their clothes, members and retainers of the Chaf family wore yellow costumes, ranging from ornate formal robes to utilitarian jumpsuits depending on their rank and duties. They controlled the planet [[Sarvchi/Legends|Sarvchi]].<ref name="SQ" />

The duties of the Chaf family, insofar as experienced by persons from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old]] and later [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], were primarily diplomatic: from about [[22 ABY/Legends|22 ABY]] onwards, in many high-level contacts with the New Republic, the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] and the [[Empire of the Hand]], the Ascendancy was represented by an [[Aristocra/Legends|Aristocra]] of the Chaf family, [[Chaf'orm'bintrano]], also known by his [[Core name/Legends|core name]], "Formbi". In [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]], the Chaf family were said to have had no oversight role over the military, but in [[22 ABY/Legends|22 ABY]] and later, Chaf'orm'bintrano held certain operational oversight over elements of the [[Chiss Expansionary Defense Force]]. As well as their public duties, the Chaf family also had special interests in areas of Chiss space; they controlled a fleet of their own combat-capable cruisers, crewed&mdash;at least in [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]]&mdash;not by CEDF warriors, but by personnel wearing the yellow [[Chiss family uniform|uniforms]] of the Family.

The Chaf family retained their position at least<ref name="SQ" /> until [[22 ABY/Legends|22 ABY]],<ref name="SQ Date" /> but during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the Chaf were absent from a reduced list of four Ruling Families supplied in a report by the [[University of Sanbra]]. House [[Nuruodo family|Nuruodo]] occupied approximately the role that they had once filled,<ref name="TC">{{GamerCite|5|The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life: The Chiss}}</ref> and they were apparently similarly absent when a Jedi [[Hunt for Zonama Sekot|mission]] visited [[Csilla/Legends|Csilla]]<ref name="FHII">''[[The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic II: Refugee]]''</ref> in [[28 ABY/Legends|28 ABY]].<ref name="FHII Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic II: Refugee]]'' to [[28 ABY/Legends|28 ABY]].</ref>

This discrepancy remained unexplained until [[35 ABY/Legends|35 ABY]],<ref name="DN1 Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]'' to [[35 ABY/Legends|35 ABY]].</ref> when it was asserted that five of the Nine Ruling Families had fallen from power due to a [[Chiss civil conflict|civil conflict]] in the Chiss Ascendancy.<ref name="DN1">''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]''</ref> Such a thing was not unprecedented as the number of Ruling Families fluctuated between three and twelve over the course of Chiss history.<ref name="OF">[[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']]</ref>
